description: Backend / REST coverage — exhaustive route × failure-class matrix, RBAC if applicable, every claimed bug independently re-validated, regression suite green. Use for pure-backend audits where there is no UI to drive (no Phase-4 personas in browser; UI gate is intentionally absent).

gates.name: api.routes.coverage
gates.description: Every declared route must be probed at least once with a happy-path test. Numerator: api.routes.tested ; denominator: api.routes.declared. Missing either metric counts as failure.

gates.name: api.failureClasses.coverage
gates.description: Each route × failure-class pair must be probed (4xx auth, 4xx not-found, 4xx invalid-input, 5xx). Numerator: api.failureClasses.covered ; denominator: api.failureClasses.declared.

gates.name: claims.validatedRatio
gates.description: Every reported bug must have been re-validated by claim-validator before clôture. claims.validated / claims.reported = 1.0.
